value.answer: Hey, the Oakville Costco isn't open yet. The one going in on Wyecroft Rd is expected later in 2027. The closest open ones I found are in Burlington at 1225 Brant St (905-336-6714), and the Laird Rd one in Mississauga, which some deals sites say serves Oakville too. Burlington's hours seem to differ between sources, so give them a call before you head over. I couldn't confirm which of the two is closer to you, so check the drive times in your maps app.
